verification.method: Recompile the fresh corpus unit with VS2012, read the COFF .text REL32 relocations, resolve each decorated symbol through inventory.tsv, patch target_va-(function_va+offset+4), and require the fully resolved byte run to equal the PE bytes at the declared IDB VA.
